name: tidex
description: Tidex monorepo - iOS app and supporting backend/web infrastructure

scripts.pages:deploy:marketing: bun run --filter marketing build && wrangler --cwd marketing pages deploy out --project-name tidex
scripts.swiftlint: sh -c 'if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; fi; for arg in "$@"; do if [ "$arg" = "--fix" ] || [ "$arg" = "autocorrect" ]; then echo "swiftlint autocorrect is disabled in this repo. Use bun run swift-format."; exit 1; fi; done; swiftlint lint "$@" && swift ios/Scripts/check-swift-imports.swift' --
scripts.swiftlint:analyze: sh -c 'if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; fi; if [ -n "$SWIFTLINT_COMPILE_COMMANDS_PATH" ]; then swiftlint analyze --strict --config .swiftlint.yml --compile-commands "$SWIFTLINT_COMPILE_COMMANDS_PATH" "$@"; elif [ -n "$SWIFTLINT_COMPILER_LOG_PATH" ]; then swiftlint analyze --strict --config .swiftlint.yml --compiler-log-path "$SWIFTLINT_COMPILER_LOG_PATH" "$@"; else echo "Set SWIFTLINT_COMPILE_COMMANDS_PATH or SWIFTLINT_COMPILER_LOG_PATH"; exit 1; fi' --
